grid = [
[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,2,1,2,2,6,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,8,8,3,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,3,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,3,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,3,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,3,8,8],
[8,8,8,3,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
[8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,3,8,8]]
pat=[2,1,2,2,6]
markers=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3]
out=[row[:] for row in grid]
# preserve embedded template by explicitly excluding its coordinates from writes
original={(1,c):grid[1][c] for c in range(2,7)}
for r,c in markers:
    for k,v in enumerate(pat):
        cc=c+k-2
        if 0<=cc<len(grid[0]) and (r,cc) not in original:
            out[r][cc]=v
for p,v in original.items(): out[p[0]][p[1]]=v
assert all(len(row)==11 for row in out) and len(out)==15
print('markers',markers)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
